overview_description.description: DevFlight wants to revamp the business model for open-source software. They’re building a marketplace to pair open-sourced developer with companies. DevFlight works with the company and developers to create a plan that helps both parties understand the scope of the project. DevFlight takes a 25 percent transaction on the deals.

product.name: Security Automation Engine
product.description: Allows IT and security teams to automate difficult and repeated tasks, reducing the need for continuous monitoring and manual intervention.

product.name: Playbook
product.description: Enables the creation of automated sequences of actions and integrations in response to detected security risks.

product.name: Configure
product.description: Integrates with existing API-driven security products to build comprehensive security flows.

product.name: Event Driven
product.description: Uses existing monitoring services like Splunk or AWS CloudWatch to trigger automations and react automatically to security events.

product.name: Open Source
product.description: Provides transparent, secure, community-driven tools, allowing users to understand the components of their security tools.

product.name: On-Premise Solution
product.description: Allows DevFlight to be run in various environments such as AWS, GCP, Azure, or on-premises, with a setup time of less than an hour.
